prompt_text: Write a poem about marshmallows as it written by dr Seuss
response_text:
**Marshmallow Munch‑Munch‑Moo!**  

In a town where the clouds are all cotton‑candy white,  
Lived a squishy‑soft squad that would bounce in the night.  
They’re puffy‑puff pillows, they’re fluffy‑fluff friends—  
The marvelous, marvelous marshmallow bends!  

They tumble‑tumble from jars on the top of the shelf,  
With a “boing‑boing‑boom!” they bounce all by themselves.  
They giggle in sugar, they wiggle in steam,  
They’re the fluffiest fluff you’ve ever seen in a dream.  

When the sun starts to sizzle and the kettle goes “hiss!”  
The marshmallows march out for a toasty‑kiss.  
They hop on a stick, they spin on a spoon,  
They melt into rivers that sing a sweet tune.  

“Come one, come all!” they shout with a grin,  
“Let’s swirl in hot cocoa, let’s dance on a tin!”  
They twirl in the chocolate, they dip in the cream,  
They turn every sip into a sugary dream.  

If you’re feeling sad, or a little bit blue,  
Just plop a marshmallow on top of your shoe—  
It’ll bounce you right up with a giggle‑glee grin,  
And you’ll float on a cloud of sweet marsh‑mallow spin!  

So here’s to the fluff, the squish, and the cheer,  
The marshmallow marvels that we hold dear.  
In a world full of wobble, of wobble‑and‑whoosh,  
They’re the soft‑silly heroes of “Munch‑Munch‑Moo!”  

— A Seussian splash of sugary rhyme,  
For every marshmallow lover, every time!
